name: mainline_role_choice_audit_v1
analysis_type: Retrospective diagnosis after stage31 outcomes were known; not a prospective experiment.
scope: All90 recorded choices across six tasks and five online arms; detailed contrasts for missed1672 and successful1675. Read JSON and NPZ only, with frozen models, pools, draws and verifier.
analysis: Reconstruct constrained TS from saved sampled objective and margin before interpreting decomposition.
Within each recorded pool cross objective sample/mean with risk margin sample/mean. Retain original feasibility-first and minimum-violation fallback semantics.
At focal neighbors separate objective-relative-mean error, objective draw innovation, risk mean bias, aleatoric scale error and constraint draw innovation.
Use only existing per-task truth cache; missing counterfactual truth remains unknown.
limits: One-step score substitutions are not a posterior ablation, independent rerun or deployed reward. Later recorded states remain conditional on actual actions. No thresholds, model fitting, new truth or follow-through on counterfactual actions.
startup_issue: One read-only inspection used unavailable python alias (exit127, before Python started); continued with installed python3, zero simulation consumption.
output_semantics: choices.mode/feasible_count describe the substituted rule. choices.selected retains original recorded scores, including original sampled_feasible; these are not recomputed posterior predictions.

next_step.scope: Frozen-risk objective-difference attribution and source-support diagnosis; no new source or target simulations.
next_step.decomposition: Within-node mean updates, integration-node mass reweighting, then common identity weights; identity-internal updates alone must not be called pure spatial conditioning.
next_step.source_boundary: Two source tasks,64sites x3repeats each, all used in the frozen fit. Existing projections diagnose source support, not held-out prediction. Native f is fitted on target initialization pilot, not a ready frozen source-law replacement.
